entries.title: Tsinghua University
entries.meta: Ph.D. in Electronic Engineering · Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR)
lines: Advised by Prof. Yunxin Liu; working closely with Prof. Ting Cao on on-device AI and embodied AI.

entries.title: OxyGen: Parallel Multi-Task VLA Inference
bullets: Unified KV-cache management across tasks and control frames for concurrent action/language generation.

bullets.text: On π0.5/RTX 4090: up to 3.7× faster, >200 language tokens/s, and 70 Hz action generation.

entries.title: ActProbe: Early Failure Detection for Robot Policies
bullets: Built a lightweight action-space probe for early failure detection in generative robot policies.

bullets.text: Expanded the accuracy–earliness Pareto-front area by 12.7%; improved unseen-task detection by 9.0%.

bullets.label: Zeva · Model
bullets.text: Frozen-policy adaptation via in-context learning over dual-timescale causal memory.

bullets.label: Zetta ζ · Harness & Infra
bullets.text: Closed-loop self-evolution with online runtime critics and recovery skills.

bullets.label: Embodied.cpp · Runtime
bullets.text: Portable VLA/WAM inference across CPU, CUDA GPU, and NPU.

entries.title: Vec-LUT: Parallel Ultra-Low-Bit LLM Inference
bullets: Introduced vector-table lookup for mixed-precision matrix multiplication in parallel ultra-low-bit LLM inference.

bullets.text: Up to 4.2× faster and 2.1× more energy-efficient across five x86/ARM devices.

entries.title: FlexNN: Efficient and Adaptive DNN Memory Management
bullets: Jointly planned layer splitting, loading, and execution for fine-grained memory control.

bullets.text: For ResNet-152 on Pixel 6 Pro, cut memory by 93.81% with 3.64% latency overhead; replanning takes about 1 s.

entries.title: ByteDance
entries.meta: Big Data Infrastructure Intern · Product Engineering & Architecture
bullets: Contributed to FaaS/serverless infrastructure for high-concurrency workloads with elastic scaling.
Optimized node image update and caching policies to reduce service cold-start overhead.

entries.title: Hisense: 2-Bit LLM Quantization and Inference
bullets: Built a 2-bit quantization-aware training and inference pipeline with vLLM integration.

bullets.text: On A100/A40, Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B INT2 stayed within 1% of BF16 accuracy and ran 1.3× faster than INT4.

entries.title: BMW: On-Device LLM Deployment for In-Car Assistants
bullets: Quantized and deployed a lightweight in-car LLM on Qualcomm hardware with llama.cpp.

bullets.text: ACM MobiSys 2026 Best Paper Award Runner-Up (2026)
